free_tier.stated: Sandbox compute bills per second at USD 0.0333 per hour for Nano (0.5 vCPU, 0.5 GiB), USD 0.0666 for Small (1 vCPU, 1 GiB), USD 0.1332 for Medium (2 vCPU, 2 GiB), USD 0.2664 for Large (4 vCPU, 4 GiB) and USD 0.5328 for XL (8 vCPU, 8 GiB). 'Every new organization receives a one-time $5 sandbox compute credit with no payment method required.' The platform plan is USD 20 a month for Build with 3 seats, USD 100 a month for Scale with 10 seats.

egress.terms: not published for sandboxes: https://everstack.ai/pricing bills sandbox compute per second and lists no sandbox egress allowance or price; hosted-site delivery is USD 0.10 per GB of response bytes delivered to visitors

interface_detail: REST API (OpenAI-compatible gateway and platform APIs), official Go, Python and TypeScript SDKs, a CLI, and sandbox SSH through SSH key and SSH token endpoints, documented at docs.everstack.ai
tooling: the official Everstack Go, Python and TypeScript (Node.js) SDKs and the Everstack CLI
chaining: The sandbox sizes line up with the whole platform: the same account supplies an AI gateway over 200 models, a vector memory store and the sandbox, so an agent can be built without a second vendor, and the sandbox is the only part billed by the second.

limits.value: Memory is 1 GiB per vCPU on every size, so a workload that needs 4 GiB of RAM has to buy a 4 vCPU box at USD 0.2664 per hour; the USD 5 credit is one per organization and does not renew.

identity_cost.detail: no payment method required: the pricing page states "Every new organization receives a one-time $5 sandbox compute credit with no payment method required", so there is no card and no hold; the credit is granted per organisation. The record does not state what signup asks for — an email address, a phone number or a company name — nor whether debit or prepaid cards are accepted later, which does not arise while no payment method is taken

evidence.proved: sandbox compute per second: Nano USD 0.0333 per hour at 0.5 vCPU and 0.5 GiB, Small USD 0.0666 at 1/1, Medium USD 0.1332 at 2/2, Large USD 0.2664 at 4/4, XL USD 0.5328 at 8/8

evidence.quote: - [API Reference](https://docs.everstack.ai/api-reference): Everstack REST API reference — OpenAI-compatible gateway and platform APIs.
- [Python](https://docs.everstack.ai/sdks/python): Official Everstack Python SDK with sync and async clients.
- [Go](https://docs.everstack.ai/sdks/go): Official Everstack Go SDK with streaming support and typed responses.
- [TypeScript / Node.js](https://docs.everstack.ai/sdks/typescript): Official Everstack Node.js SDK for gateway and platform APIs.
- [Get Started](https://docs.everstack.ai/getting-started/installation): Sign up for Everstack Cloud and install the CLI.

notes: Rate per vCPU-hour works out to USD 0.0666 flat, which is a quarter above ix's USD 0.0288 and double Bunny's USD 0.02, and the RAM ratio is the reason: 1 GiB per vCPU is tight for a build that compiles anything. The USD 5 credit at USD 0.0666 per hour is 75 hours of Small. Whether sandbox compute requires the USD 20 Build plan is not stated on the pricing page; the credit is offered to a new organization with no payment method, which implies at least a trial path without one. Isolation technology not read. Documentation exposes an llms.txt and an OpenAPI index, so the API surface is testable without a browser.
